talents.e: Raises Strength by a percentage that grows with points invested.
Boosts total Intellect by a percentage that scales with ranks.
Adds Holy Shock to the healing bonus from Holy Light and Flash of Light.
Chance that taking damage won't interrupt Flash, Holy Light, or Light's Vigil casts.
Raises damage from your Seals and Judgements by a larger percentage.
Shortens the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you.
Brief immunity to silences and interrupts on a long cooldown.
Keeps a larger share of mana regeneration active while casting.
Cuts Cleanse and Purify mana costs and shortens Exorcism and Holy Wrath cooldowns.
Holy Shock and Flash crits shorten your next Holy Light cast.
Crit heals can restore mana, now including Light's Vigil casts.
Makes your next healing spell a guaranteed critical on a long cooldown.
Greatly raises your hit chance with Holy spells.
Deals Holy damage to foes or heals allies on a short cooldown.
Bonus Holy damage against the first few enemies entering Consecration.
Raises crit chance strongly for Holy Shock and Holy Strike, slightly for others.
Marks a target so your next Holy Shock damages foes or heals allies.
Increases armor from gear by a percentage.
Melee hits against you can trigger a temporary boost to block chance.
Raises your chance to hit by a few percent.
Shortens Blessing of Protection cooldown and extends Blessing of Freedom.
Raises your Defense skill.
Absorbing hits with Seal of Fury's shield restores mana, more against higher-level attackers.
Reduces all damage taken while Righteous Fury is active.
Increases shield absorption and sometimes restores mana on blocks.
Adds Stamina and shortens Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark cooldowns.
Resets Judgement's cooldown and makes your next Judgement cost no mana.
Raises damage dealt with one-handed melee weapons.
Shortens the cooldown of Hammer of Justice.
Grants a large absorb shield for a short time, then applies Forbearance.
Chance for extra attacks after blocking and after non-periodic critical hits against you.
Raises Holy Strike threat and, with Righteous Fury, cuts damage taken.
Stronger block bonus with more Holy damage for each attack blocked.
Raises your parry chance.
Reduces the mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities.
Shortens the cooldown of Judgement.
Cuts mana costs of Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath.
Raises your melee critical strike chance.
Melee hits may lower the target's Strength and Agility.
Judgement reliably returns mana from the judged seal.
Seal that adds Holy damage to hits and a stronger judgement burst when unleashed.
Increases movement speed and mounted speed.
Critical hits against you reflect a share of damage back to the attacker.
Boosts Holy Strike damage and refreshes Judgement effects on the target.
Raises damage dealt with two-handed melee weapons.
Stacking damage bonus after landing non-periodic critical strikes.
Incapacitates a humanoid until it takes damage, on a cooldown.
Adds spell damage scaled by a large share of your Intellect.
Shortens Hammer of Wrath cast time and cuts threat without Righteous Fury.
Cuts Seal mana costs and echoes replaced seals into your next melee hit.
